pairs.evidence: companion/index.html:213 The served companion page returns immediately when hidden without closing its WebSocket and lacks page-hide/page-show lifecycle handling, violating the connection cleanup required for navigation reuse.

techniques.evidence: companion/index.html:78 The initial interface and styles are inline in served HTML; subsequent thumbnails are session data rather than first-render subresources.
companion/index.html:14 The companion uses system fonts, which the technique explicitly exempts.
companion/index.html:257 An initial pairing refusal reveals a form above the drawing surface; its default display:none reserves no space, so the late response changes the layout.
companion/index.html:181 The page opens a long-lived socket but has no pagehide cleanup or pageshow restoration handler; visibilitychange only reconnects.
companion/index.html:338 The later thumbnail is a data URL supplied by the session; the initial document has no competing fetched images, fonts, or scripts requiring priority hints.
